detaileddescription.para: The µTest++ project is a lightweight, macro-free, modern C++ testing framework with TAP output, purpose-built for embedded systems development.

With its clean and expressive C++ API, µTest++ enables developers to write, organise, and execute unit tests with minimal overhead. The library includes advanced features such as test suites, test cases, and detailed reporting, all tailored to meet the specific needs of embedded environments.

Test results are reported in the TAP (Test Anything Protocol) format by default, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of continuous integration systems and TAP-aware test harnesses. A human-readable reporter is also available for interactive use.
Output verbosity is fully configurable via command-line options, allowing users to choose between concise summaries and comprehensive diagnostic information to best suit their workflow.
By adopting µTest++, you can achieve robust and maintainable code through systematic and automated testing, supporting professional software engineering practices across your entire project.
